name: – After § 1 – Am 15
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the impact of the Turkish invasion on Cypriot women and girls, and the crimes committed by Turkish forces and consequences on gender equality
part_text: 1a. Notes that 52 years after the Turkish invasion and the illegal occupation of over 36 % of the territory of the Republic of Cyprus, a Member State of the EU, the division of the island continues, constituting a serious and ongoing violation of international law, EU values and the sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity of a Member State;
